title: ‘Lanterns’ Writer Responds to Buzzy Episode Three Reaction: “I Just Hope People Will Stick It Out With John”
summary: Co-executive producer and "Outkast" writer Vanessa Baden Kelly had anxiety leading up: "I was having heart palpitations,” she tells The Hollywood Reporter. But now, she says the debates viewers are having are "the exact one we were hoping to have,” as she looks to what comes next in the HBO Max series.
